package agent

// Independent adversarial review r33 unit proofs for Engine callers of
// Meter.CheckpointForRestart (preserveServingOnStop in restart.go:190 and
// settleExpiredBindings in deadlines.go:90) at commit
// 29cd267162fa614c444122865b62f405e2f58802.
// TEST ONLY manual clocks, in-memory data planes, and temp SQLite.

import (
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/google/uuid"

	"github.com/TED-H-com/Freedom-VPN/node/enforce"
	"github.com/TED-H-com/Freedom-VPN/node/internal/meter"
)

func alignMicrosecond(r *rig) {
	if rem := r.clock.Wall().Nanosecond() % 1000; rem != 0 {
		r.clock.Advance(time.Duration(1000-rem) * time.Nanosecond)
	}
}

// TestR33_AgentPreserveServingOnStopAtSameTimestampAndRollback proves that
// Engine.Close() -> preserveServingOnStop -> Meter.CheckpointForRestart:
//   - preserves the open usage epoch and retains kernel serving rules for
//     same-boot adoption when counter readings are unchanged at now == LastSample
//     (0s) and bounded rollback within timeanchor's 2s skew window (1s, 2s), and
//   - refuses preservation (returning false and running handoff baseline
//     withdrawal) when counter readings changed at now <= LastSample.
func TestR33_AgentPreserveServingOnStopAtSameTimestampAndRollback(t *testing.T) {
	for _, rollback := range []time.Duration{0, time.Second, 2 * time.Second} {
		t.Run("unchanged_counters_"+rollback.String(), func(t *testing.T) {
			r := newRig(t)
			alignMicrosecond(r)
			alignControlClock(r)
			r.srv.SetUsageUnavailable(1000)

			serveBoundGeneration(t, r)
			r.manualUsage(t)
			b := r.eng.appliedModel.Bindings[0]
			upName := meter.CounterName(b.DeviceID, meter.DirUpload)

			src1 := &r20DynamicSource{
				boot:     r.eng.bootID.String(),
				bindings: r.eng.meterBindings,
				counters: map[string]enforce.CounterValue{
					upName: {Packets: 4, Bytes: 4096},
				},
			}
			r.eng.meter.Close()
			var err error
			r.eng.meter, err = meter.New(meter.Config{
				NodeID:        r.eng.nodeID,
				IncarnationID: r.eng.incID,
				Store:         r.eng.usage,
				Source:        src1,
				Interval:      10 * time.Second,
				Now:           r.clock.Wall,
			})
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}

			// Advance 10s and sample 4096 B so head.LastSample == t0+10s.
			r.clock.Advance(10 * time.Second)
			if err := r.eng.meter.Sample(t.Context()); err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("Sample before Close: %v", err)
			}
			hBefore, err := r.eng.usage.Head(t.Context())
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			epochBefore := hBefore.OpenEpoch
			lastSampleBefore := hBefore.LastSample
			baselinesBefore := r.plane.baselines

			// Step wall clock back by rollback (0s, 1s, or 2s) with unchanged counters.
			if rollback > 0 {
				r.clock.JumpWall(-rollback)
			}
			if err := r.eng.Close(); err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("Close at rollback=%s: %v", rollback, err)
			}
			if r.plane.baselines != baselinesBefore {
				t.Fatalf("Close at rollback=%s with unchanged counters withdrew to baseline (%d -> %d)",
					rollback, baselinesBefore, r.plane.baselines)
			}

			// Restore wall clock and boot successor Engine on the same boot.
			if rollback > 0 {
				r.clock.JumpWall(rollback)
			}
			r.clock.Advance(2 * time.Second)
			src2 := &r20DynamicSource{
				boot: src1.boot,
				counters: map[string]enforce.CounterValue{
					upName: {Packets: 4, Bytes: 4096},
				},
			}
			next := r20Successor(t, r, r.eng.cfg, src2, r.plane)
			if err := next.Boot(t.Context()); err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("successor Boot: %v", err)
			}
			if !next.serving || r.plane.baselines != baselinesBefore {
				t.Fatalf("successor did not adopt retained serving after Close at rollback=%s: serving=%v baselines=%d->%d",
					rollback, next.serving, baselinesBefore, r.plane.baselines)
			}
			hAdopted, err := next.usage.Head(t.Context())
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if hAdopted.OpenEpoch != epochBefore || !hAdopted.LastSample.Equal(lastSampleBefore) {
				t.Fatalf("adopted head mismatch: OpenEpoch=%s (want %s) LastSample=%s (want %s)",
					hAdopted.OpenEpoch, epochBefore, hAdopted.LastSample, lastSampleBefore)
			}

			// Advance traffic by +2048 B on successor and verify exact-once attribution.
			r.eng = next
			r.manualUsage(t)
			src2.setBindings(next.meterBindings)
			next.meter.Close()
			next.meter, err = meter.New(meter.Config{
				NodeID:        next.nodeID,
				IncarnationID: next.incID,
				Store:         next.usage,
				Source:        src2,
				Interval:      10 * time.Second,
				Now:           r.clock.Wall,
			})
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			r.clock.Advance(10 * time.Second)
			src2.setCounter(upName, enforce.CounterValue{Packets: 6, Bytes: 4096 + 2048})
			if err := next.meter.Sample(t.Context()); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			led := r21ReadLedger(t, next.cfg, next.nodeID, next.incID)
			if got := led.byMemberRev[r21MemberRev{member: b.MemberID, rev: b.BindingRevision}]; got != 4096+2048 || len(led.gaps) != 0 {
				t.Fatalf("post-adoption ledger: got=%d (want %d) gaps=%+v", got, 4096+2048, led.gaps)
			}
		})
	}

	t.Run("changed_counters_at_rollback_refuses_preservation_and_withdraws", func(t *testing.T) {
		r := newRig(t)
		alignMicrosecond(r)
		alignControlClock(r)
		r.srv.SetUsageUnavailable(1000)

		serveBoundGeneration(t, r)
		r.manualUsage(t)
		b := r.eng.appliedModel.Bindings[0]
		upName := meter.CounterName(b.DeviceID, meter.DirUpload)

		src1 := &r20DynamicSource{
			boot:     r.eng.bootID.String(),
			bindings: r.eng.meterBindings,
			counters: map[string]enforce.CounterValue{
				upName: {Packets: 4, Bytes: 4096},
			},
		}
		r.eng.meter.Close()
		var err error
		r.eng.meter, err = meter.New(meter.Config{
			NodeID:        r.eng.nodeID,
			IncarnationID: r.eng.incID,
			Store:         r.eng.usage,
			Source:        src1,
			Interval:      10 * time.Second,
			Now:           r.clock.Wall,
		})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		r.clock.Advance(10 * time.Second)
		if err := r.eng.meter.Sample(t.Context()); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		baselinesBefore := r.plane.baselines

		// Advance counter bytes while stepping wall clock back 1s (within timeanchor
		// 2s skew bound): CheckpointForRestart returns ErrHold, so preserveServingOnStop
		// returns false and shutdownUsage runs handoff (installing baseline).
		src1.setCounter(upName, enforce.CounterValue{Packets: 5, Bytes: 5120})
		r.clock.JumpWall(-time.Second)
		if err := r.eng.Close(); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if r.plane.baselines <= baselinesBefore {
			t.Fatalf("expected Close with changed counters at rollback to run baseline handoff, baselines remained %d", r.plane.baselines)
		}
	})
}

// TestR33_AgentSettleExpiredBindingsAtSameTimestampAndRollback proves that
// Decide(r.eng.input()) -> r.eng.enforce -> settleExpiredBindings -> Meter.CheckpointForRestart:
//   - settles an expired sibling binding in place without closing the open
//     usage epoch or withdrawing the surviving sibling to baseline when counter
//     readings are unchanged at now == LastSample (0s) or a 1s rollback, and
//   - rejects in-place settlement (withdrawing to baseline and setting
//     retainedPending) when counter readings changed at now <= LastSample.
func TestR33_AgentSettleExpiredBindingsAtSameTimestampAndRollback(t *testing.T) {
	for _, rollback := range []time.Duration{0, time.Second} {
		t.Run("unchanged_counters_"+rollback.String(), func(t *testing.T) {
			r := f42Siblings(t, false)
			alignMicrosecond(r)
			r.srv.SetUsageUnavailable(1000)
			bindings := r.eng.meterBindings()
			src := &r20DynamicSource{
				boot:     r.eng.bootID.String(),
				bindings: r.eng.meterBindings,
				counters: map[string]enforce.CounterValue{},
			}
			for _, b := range bindings {
				src.setCounter(meter.CounterName(b.DeviceID, meter.DirUpload), enforce.CounterValue{Packets: 2, Bytes: 2048})
			}
			r.eng.meter.Close()
			var err error
			r.eng.meter, err = meter.New(meter.Config{
				NodeID:        r.eng.nodeID,
				IncarnationID: r.eng.incID,
				Store:         r.eng.usage,
				Source:        src,
				Interval:      10 * time.Second,
				Now:           r.clock.Wall,
			})
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}

			// Advance monotonic + wall clock to the first sibling's expiry deadline
			// and take a sample so head.LastSample == deadline wall time.
			r.clock.Advance(r.eng.policyExpires - r.clock.Mono())
			alignMicrosecond(r)
			if err := r.eng.meter.Sample(t.Context()); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			hBefore, err := r.eng.usage.Head(t.Context())
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			baselinesBefore := r.plane.baselines
			appliesBefore := r.plane.applies

			// Step wall clock back by rollback (0s or 1s) while keeping monotonic
			// time at policyExpires and counter readings unchanged.
			if rollback > 0 {
				r.clock.JumpWall(-rollback)
			}
			d := Decide(r.eng.input())
			if !d.Serve || !r.eng.onlyExpiredBindingsRemoved(d.Model) {
				t.Fatalf("expected expired-only sibling removal: Serve=%v Reasons=%v", d.Serve, d.Reasons)
			}
			if err := r.eng.enforce(t.Context(), d); err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("enforce expired sibling at rollback=%s: %v", rollback, err)
			}
			hAfter, err := r.eng.usage.Head(t.Context())
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if !r.eng.serving || len(r.plane.last.Bindings) != 1 || r.plane.baselines != baselinesBefore || r.plane.applies != appliesBefore+1 {
				t.Fatalf("survivor transition failed at rollback=%s: serving=%v bindings=%d baselines=%d->%d applies=%d->%d",
					rollback, r.eng.serving, len(r.plane.last.Bindings), baselinesBefore, r.plane.baselines, appliesBefore, r.plane.applies)
			}
			if hAfter.OpenEpoch == uuid.Nil || hAfter.OpenEpoch != hBefore.OpenEpoch || !hAfter.LastSample.Equal(hBefore.LastSample) {
				t.Fatalf("expired settlement altered open epoch or LastSample: got %+v, want %+v", hAfter, hBefore)
			}
		})
	}

	t.Run("changed_counters_at_rollback_withdraws_and_keeps_retained_pending", func(t *testing.T) {
		r := f42Siblings(t, false)
		alignMicrosecond(r)
		r.srv.SetUsageUnavailable(1000)
		bindings := r.eng.meterBindings()
		src := &r20DynamicSource{
			boot:     r.eng.bootID.String(),
			bindings: r.eng.meterBindings,
			counters: map[string]enforce.CounterValue{},
		}
		for _, b := range bindings {
			src.setCounter(meter.CounterName(b.DeviceID, meter.DirUpload), enforce.CounterValue{Packets: 2, Bytes: 2048})
		}
		r.eng.meter.Close()
		var err error
		r.eng.meter, err = meter.New(meter.Config{
			NodeID:        r.eng.nodeID,
			IncarnationID: r.eng.incID,
			Store:         r.eng.usage,
			Source:        src,
			Interval:      10 * time.Second,
			Now:           r.clock.Wall,
		})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}

		// Sample at the first sibling's expiry deadline, then advance counters
		// while stepping wall clock back 1s so CheckpointForRestart returns ErrHold.
		r.clock.Advance(r.eng.policyExpires - r.clock.Mono())
		alignMicrosecond(r)
		if err := r.eng.meter.Sample(t.Context()); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		for _, b := range bindings {
			src.setCounter(meter.CounterName(b.DeviceID, meter.DirUpload), enforce.CounterValue{Packets: 3, Bytes: 3072})
		}
		r.clock.JumpWall(-time.Second)
		appliesBefore := r.plane.applies
		baselinesBefore := r.plane.baselines

		d := Decide(r.eng.input())
		if !d.Serve || !r.eng.onlyExpiredBindingsRemoved(d.Model) {
			t.Fatalf("expected expired-only sibling removal: Serve=%v Reasons=%v", d.Serve, d.Reasons)
		}
		if err := r.eng.enforce(t.Context(), d); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if r.eng.serving || r.plane.applies != appliesBefore || r.plane.baselines <= baselinesBefore || !r.eng.retainedPending {
			t.Fatalf("expected failed settlement to withdraw and keep retainedPending: serving=%v applies=%d->%d baselines=%d->%d retainedPending=%v",
				r.eng.serving, appliesBefore, r.plane.applies, baselinesBefore, r.plane.baselines, r.eng.retainedPending)
		}
	})
}
